prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for all change types (home new_flow, finish new_screen, sign_in hint, choose_path copy) because each kind of change has only been tested once.
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, copy: -0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +4.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: -1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] adoption_stage_layout_redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a stage layout featuring high-contrast choice cards and animated pet previews. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%) and long completion times (median 89s), indicating user hesitation during pet selection.)
1: [home, new_flow] generation_progress_checklist_flow: Add a visual step-by-step processing checklist sub-flow during the waiting screen to give real-time progress feedback. (why: The waiting phase has high mean duration (2336s) and support receives bug reports regarding app stalling or pet creation failing silently.)
2: [sign_in, hint] account_sync_warning_hint: Add a warning hint on the sign-in screen advising returning users to log in with their original auth provider. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in with a secondary account.)
3: [choose_path, layout] choose_path_split_layout: Switch the path selection screen layout to a split view clearly distinguishing preset pets from custom creations. (why: The choose_path step takes a mean time of 514s and drops nearly 24% of users.)
4: [home, wait_info] waiting_estimated_time_counter: Display an active time estimate and progress bar on the waiting screen while pet generation finishes. (why: Home dropoff is 12.6% with high mean completion time (2336s), showing users lose patience without time expectations.)
5: [finish, copy] finish_welcome_headline_copy: Update the home intro text to explain how the pet launches onto the desktop background upon completion. (why: Finish step loses 35.2% of remaining users and support reports pets failing to display on desktop after setup.)
6: [home, notification] desktop_pet_ready_desktop_notification: Enable desktop notification opt-ins on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet generation completes. (why: Long wait times cause users to minimize or forget the desktop app during pet generation.)
7: [adoption, incentive] custom_pet_certificate_stamp: Add an animated official seal badge and badge milestone component to the adoption certificate view. (why: Boosts emotional payoff and completion rate at the end of the adoption step (60.9% conversion).)
